canonical_data: workflow definitions, credentials, and execution history in the instance database
current_repo_note: A workflow-automation platform whose AI agent nodes qualify it as a builder of tool-using agents; the agent surface, not general automation, is what is scored.
strengths: Agent, agent-tool, memory, guardrail, and MCP client and server nodes sit beside 1,500-plus integrations, so agents act through systems a team already connects
Human approvals, execution history, role-based access, and audit trails are part of the platform, and it can be self-hosted with Docker
The README lists more than 9,000 workflow templates, and the project has the largest star count in this batch
weaknesses: The Sustainable Use License limits use to internal business purposes or non-commercial use and bars paid redistribution, so it is not open source
Files marked .ee need a paid enterprise license for production use, and the README says enterprise licences add features
Agents are one node type inside a general automation product, so agent behaviour is shaped by the workflow around it
why_it_matters: The most widely deployed workflow tool to treat AI agents as nodes, which makes it the practical entry point for teams that want agents wired into existing systems.
